snippet.title: Elyndor - Gameplay | 1v1 PvP Card Game
snippet.description:
Elyndor is a 1v1 online PvP card game set in a dark fantasy universe where five factions battle for supremacy.

🃏 Choose your faction and build your deck
⚔️ Challenge other players in real-time matches
🌑 Explore a deep dark fantasy universe

#Elyndor #CardGame #PvP #IndieGame #DarkFantasy
